scripts.lint: npx textlint ./articles/*.md ./books/cloud-competition/*.md ./books/zig-blockchain/*.md && npx textlint --config .textlintrc.en ./leanpub/cloud-competition-en/*.md && node scripts/validate-english-book.mjs
scripts.lint:fix: npx textlint --fix ./articles/*.md ./books/cloud-competition/*.md ./books/zig-blockchain/*.md && npx textlint --fix --config .textlintrc.en ./leanpub/cloud-competition-en/*.md && node scripts/validate-english-book.mjs
scripts.validate:mermaid: node scripts/validate-mermaid.mjs books/zig-blockchain && node scripts/validate-mermaid.mjs leanpub/cloud-competition-en
